```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
d <- read.csv("study_data_clean.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
N <- nrow(d)

cq_tbl <- data.frame(
  Question = c("CQ1", "CQ2", "CQ3", "CQ4"),
  Content = c(
    "What counts as a correct endorser prediction?",
    "How much do you start with per decision? ($0.50)",
    "You wager 50%, endorser was right — what do you earn? ($0.75)",
    "How is your total bonus calculated? (Sum of both)"
  ),
  Correct = c(sum(d$cq1_correct), sum(d$cq2_correct),
              sum(d$cq3_correct), sum(d$cq4_correct)),
  Total = N,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Rate = sprintf("%.1f%%", Correct / Total * 100))

kable(cq_tbl,
      col.names = c("Question", "What it asks", "Correct", "Total", "Pass Rate"),
      booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "Comprehension check pass rates by question")
```

```{r}
score_tbl <- d %>%
  count(cq_score) %>%
  mutate(Pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", n / sum(n) * 100))

kable(score_tbl,
      col.names = c("CQ Score (out of 4)", "N", "%"),
      booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "Distribution of comprehension check scores")
```
